borrowed.title: On a borrowed phone
borrowed.handPin: Only {name} makes the PIN and opens {name}'s person. Look away for those.
borrowed.handHide: {name} hides the person again before handing the phone back.
borrowed.handFace: No Face ID here: it's your phone, not {name}'s.
borrowed.handBackLine: Then hand the phone back to {owner}.
borrowed.hidden: {name}'s person is hidden again. Nobody holding this phone can see who it is.
borrowed.nothingShown: {name}'s PIN is made. There's no person to open yet, so nothing was shown.
borrowed.nextHelp: Next, {owner} can help with {name}'s sizes and list.
borrowed.doneLead: This is your phone, so it forgets {name} now. {name}'s list and person stay safe.
borrowed.nextTime: Next time, on {name}'s own phone: open the same key, or ask {organizer} for a new one.
borrowed.hideFailed: Couldn't hide it. Check the connection and try again.
borrowed.signOutFailed: Couldn't sign {name} out. Check the connection and try again.
borrowed.revealFailed: Couldn't open the person. Check the connection and try again.
